verdict.rationale: Asana's REST API reference states that every endpoint has a built-in, in-context API explorer for making live requests and seeing responses, which directly delivers an interactive reference with runnable calls. It is backed by a developer sandbox domain for safe testing and a published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the explorer, and evidence of copyable per-language code samples beyond the in-page request runner.
